original_query: select s_acctbal, s_name, n_name, p_partkey, p_mfgr, s_address, s_phone, s_comment from part, supplier, partsupp, nation, region where p_partkey = ps_partkey and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey and p_size = 6 and p_type like '%NICKEL' and s_nationkey = n_nationkey and n_regionkey = r_regionkey and r_name = 'EUROPE' and ps_supplycost = ( select min(ps_supplycost) from partsupp, supplier, nation, region where p_partkey = ps_partkey and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey and s_nationkey = n_nationkey and n_regionkey = r_regionkey and r_name = 'EUROPE' ) order by s_acctbal desc, n_name, s_name, p_partkey limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH target_parts AS (
    SELECT p_partkey, p_mfgr
    FROM part
    WHERE p_size = 6
      AND p_type LIKE '%NICKEL'
),
europe_suppliers AS (
    SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone, s.s_acctbal, s.s_comment, n.n_name
    FROM supplier s
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
),
min_supplycost AS (
    SELECT ps.ps_partkey, MIN(ps.ps_supplycost) AS min_supplycost
    FROM partsupp ps
    JOIN target_parts tp ON ps.ps_partkey = tp.p_partkey
    JOIN europe_suppliers es ON ps.ps_suppkey = es.s_suppkey
    GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey
)
SELECT es.s_acctbal, es.s_name, es.n_name, tp.p_partkey, tp.p_mfgr,
       es.s_address, es.s_phone, es.s_comment
FROM target_parts tp
JOIN min_supplycost msc ON tp.p_partkey = msc.ps_partkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = msc.ps_partkey
                AND ps.ps_supplycost = msc.min_supplycost
JOIN europe_suppliers es ON ps.ps_suppkey = es.s_suppkey
ORDER BY es.s_acctbal DESC, es.n_name, es.s_name, tp.p_partkey
LIMIT 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Replace the correlated MIN(ps_supplycost) subquery (evaluated per candidate row) with a pre-aggregated CTE that computes the minimum supply cost once per target part among European suppliers.
Extract highly selective part filters (p_size = 6 AND p_type LIKE '%NICKEL') into a target_parts CTE so the expensive partsupp aggregation is restricted to only the relevant parts.

Pre-filter European suppliers (supplier JOIN nation JOIN region) into a reusable CTE, eliminating repeated nation/region joins and applying the region filter early; also join supplier details through this CTE in the final query.

Preserve tie semantics: join back to partsupp on the computed minimum cost and filter to European suppliers, so all suppliers achieving the minimum cost per part are returned exactly as in the original query.
